aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.shield_br: Activate with your shield raised. For 3 seconds, attacks you block from the front knock you back 90% less and deal 65% less damage to the shield. You move 25% slower while braced.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.counterat: Activate within 2.5 seconds of blocking. Your next melee hit on that attacker within 3 seconds deals 70% more damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.heavy_str: Your next heavy-weapon hit within 3 seconds deals 50% more damage and interrupts a skeleton drawing its bow or an ordinary pillager loading its crossbow. Use an axe, mace, heavy blade or heavy scythe.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.slowing_s: Fire your next ordinary arrow from a regular bow within 5 seconds. A hit slows the target by 60% for 4 seconds.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.marking_s: Fire an ordinary arrow from a regular bow within 5 seconds to mark a target in sight. Your first follow-up ordinary arrow to hit it within 7 seconds deals 70% more damage and spends the mark.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.quick_sho: Your next ordinary arrow from a regular bow within 5 seconds reaches full draw in 9 ticks instead of 20 and deals 90% of normal damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.disengage: Move back up to 5 blocks along solid ground while keeping your facing. For 1.5 seconds, the first direct melee hit against you deals half damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.dash.name: Dash
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.dash.desc: Move forward up to 6 blocks along solid ground. Your next light-weapon hit within 2.5 seconds adds 35% of the strike’s normal damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.flank_str: Your first light-weapon hit from the side or rear within 3 seconds deals 85% more damage. Use a knife, dagger or amethyst rapier.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.shield_sh: Block an attack with your shield, then use this technique to shove the nearby attacker away.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.wide_shie: Shield Shove also pushes nearby enemies in front of you. It still requires a successful block and uses the same cooldown.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.last_stan: Survive an enemy hit that drops you to low health. For a short time, your next fully charged melee hit deals more damage. Activates automatically.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.offensive: Activate with a heavy weapon. You take more damage while the stance lasts. Each fully charged heavy-weapon hit speeds up your next heavy-weapon swing while the stance is active.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.reason.te: Block successful. You can briefly use Shield Shove.

aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.duelist_p: Activate with a light weapon just before a frontal melee hit to soften it. After a successful parry, you can attack the same opponent once with a shorter recovery.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.reason.te: Parried. Your next swing against this opponent is quicker.
